messages.subject: Ben | Industrial & Natural Resources Executive | ESG, Government Relations and Global Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Ben,

Your leadership of EMA Partners Japan's Industrial Practice and track record placing senior executives into multinational companies makes this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior international mandates where industrial growth depends on institutional relationships, ESG and disciplined stakeholder execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage and carbon-data readiness. My experience working within a Chinese multinational group and completing executive development in China gives me additional cross-cultural exposure relevant to Asia-based leadership environments.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership in industrial, energy, mining and infrastructure businesses. I am internationally mobile and open to Japan, wider APAC, the Middle East and other global assignments.

I have attached an EMA Partners Japan-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for suitable current or upcoming searches.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
